en.headline: New and growing businesses in {region} that need cover
en.subheadline: Every week {firma} gets businesses registered around {ort} in recent weeks, plus local firms that are hiring or expanding – the moments when liability, property and employer cover are arranged.

signals.title: Newly registered companies
signals.text: A new company needs public liability and, once it hires, employers' liability – usually within its first weeks of trading.

signals.title: Growth and hiring
signals.text: Firms taking on several people at once often outgrow their existing cover and review it.

signals.title: Checked and sourced
signals.text: Each lead shows the company, date, address and the official record, so {firma} can qualify it quickly.

faq.a: Only companies in the areas you choose – for example {region} – with a fresh, dated event that gives you a reason to get in touch. Each lead is delivered to you once.

faq.q: Where does the data come from?
faq.a: Official company registers, official announcements and companies' own careers pages. We do not use LinkedIn, job boards or other platforms whose terms forbid it.

faq.q: Is there personal data in the leads?
faq.a: No. Company data only: name, address, website, main phone number where published, the event and its source.

faq.q: How does this fit a commercial broker?
faq.a: Brokers grow by reaching businesses before renewal habits form. The weekly list gives your team timely prospects in {region} with a concrete reason to talk.

faq.q: What does the free sample include?
faq.a: 10 current leads from {region}, with the same fields as the weekly delivery. No obligation, no card required.
